title: -able words, to carry & to wear
summary: Words ending in -able are usually the same in French: probable, confortable, adorable. Remove -able and add -er to get the verb: adorable → adorer, séparable → séparer, portable → porter (to carry / to wear). 'Must' can also mean 'probably': Elle doit t'adorer.
points: -able words carry over: probable, confortable, adorable, inséparable, la table.
porter = to carry and to wear: Je veux porter un pantalon noir.
devoir can mean 'must be the case': Elle doit t'adorer (She must adore you).
Hearing a consonant at the end (la barbe) is a clue that the word ends in -e, and often that it's feminine.
porter la barbe = to have a beard.
drills: I want to wear black trousers.
Je veux porter un pantalon noir.
I want to grow a beard.
